newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Bank Sarasin to set up Geneva company.
newsitem.headline: Bank Sarasin to set up Geneva company.

text.p: Bank Sarasin & Co said it will establish an investment advisory and asset management company in Geneva, Sarasin Geneva Ltd.
"Geneva is clearly an important centre for international private banking, something which strongly influenced Bank Sarasin's decision to offer its services from this city," it said.
It said Albert Gowen, 53, would be chief executive officer of the new Geneva operations. The board will be chaired by Eric Sarasin, partner of Bank Sarasin & Co.
Details of the new company, which is in addition to offices in Basle, Zurich and London, will be made public in June.
The bank, with eight partners, is considered to be one of Switzerland's top four strictly private banks where the partners have unlimited liability.
It has roughly five billion Swiss francs under management for institutional clients, mutual funds of 1.8 billion, and does not publish assets under management for private accounts.
